history.summary: A 936 sqft freehold 2BR at The Promenade @ Pelikat (2016) in D19 Kovan/Hougang at $1.23M ($1,314 PSF), 820m from Kovan NE13 MRT. A freehold 2BR at a low PSF and accessible quantum, but this is a mixed-use development with a reputation for retail-podium vacancy that can weigh on the residential.
history.rating_rationale: Positives: freehold tenure, $1,314 PSF is cheap for a freehold 2BR, $1.23M is a very liquid quantum, and it's on the cost-frontier. The 936 sqft 2BR is generous (slightly oversized). Concerns: The Promenade @ Pelikat is a mixed commercial/residential project whose retail podium has had well-documented occupancy struggles, which can dampen ambience and resale appeal, and the sub-.500 arena record (193-223) reflects that. 820m to Kovan MRT is a 10-min walk. Cheap freehold entry vs mixed-use stigma nets to Neutral.
red_flags: Mixed-use development with a troubled/under-occupied retail podium
No URA appreciation/txn data to confirm trajectory
catalysts: Cost-frontier listing; Kovan/Hougang amenities and NE line nearby

history.summary: Freehold but in a mixed commercial/residential development (270 retail + 164 resi) with softening prices, management complaints, and an asking that sits right at the project average — the 'cheap' read is a district age artifact, not a real discount.
history.rating_rationale: Asking $1,314 psf is essentially AT the project's last-12-month average (~$1,315 psf, range $1,188-$1,532), so the algo's -24.6% age-adj 'cheap vs district' is a district/age artifact, not a unit-level bargain — the +8.9% cohort premium (on only 3 txns) actually says it is slightly rich within its band. More important, this is a mixed development (270 commercial + 164 residential units), a structure that historically lags pure-residential on capital appreciation; project PSF has SOFTENED ~-4.83% over 2023-2026, and reviews flag a poorly-regarded managing council. D19 OCR is a forward positive, and freehold + Kovan MRT proximity help, but the mixed-dev drag, falling prices and absence of any verified value edge outweigh that for a 5-7yr appreciation hold.
red_flags: Mixed development (270 retail + 164 residential units) — structurally weaker capital-appreciation profile and harder financing
Project PSF softened ~-4.83% over 2023-2026 — negative recent trend
Asking ~at project average; the -24.6% 'cheap' is a district-age artifact, and +8.9% vs cohort (3 txns) suggests it is slightly rich in-band
Resident reviews flag a disliked/poorly-managed managing council
catalysts: OCR district (favorable v3.4 forward region) and walkable to Kovan MRT
Retail directly below offers convenience for an own-stay buyer
